verdict.rationale: React's component-based architecture, composability, React Compiler for automatic performance optimization, dev tools for diagnosing performance issues, and ecosystem frameworks (Next.js, React Router) for scaling full apps all support building large, maintainable, fast-growing codebases. Community evidence corroborates React's efficient DOM update model and scalability claims, though some skepticism about internal complexity exists. missing for 10: independent large-scale case studies/benchmarks showing maintainability at massive team scale, and hands-on evidence of React Compiler's real-world performance gains over time.
